sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-KSM key (RB-KSM) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base Military unit Headquarters' doctor's office.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a mandatory quest location for the quest Disease History.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Second floor of the HQ (White Bishop) building on Reserve. (Highlighted in green)

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Medical supplies)
- One Sports bag
